SmartDraw is useful if you need scaled 2D diagrams more than home design generation. You can draw walls, set exact dimensions, import an existing floor plan as an image or PDF, draw to scale, use layers, and export as PDF, PNG, or SVG.

SmartDraw doesn't have AI floor plan generation features. Use it when you already have a sketch, PDF, image, or clear dimensions and want to turn that into a cleaner scaled diagram. It's also more broadly focused on building layouts, offices, facilities, and other diagram-style plans, not just home design.

SmartDraw is best for documentation, diagramming, and early layout communication. It isn't the right choice if you want software to generate new residential layout options from room requirements, site constraints, or a blank canvas.

### Pros: [...] ### Pros:

 Strong for tracing over an existing plan image or PDF
 Supports scaled 2D floor plan diagrams
 Useful when the layout is already known
 Offers simple exports for documentation or sharing

### Cons:

 Does not generate floor plans with AI
 Limited for 3D home visualization
 Less focused on furniture and interior design workflows
 Not ideal for blank-canvas design exploration

### 4. Floorplanner: Best Browser-Based Floor Planning Tool

Floorplanner is a browser-based tool focused on accessible floor planning. It emphasizes easy room drawing, moving walls, adding doors and windows, real-time 3D views, and a large 3D model library. Floorplanner also says users can recreate spaces without software downloads or training and create 2D and 3D visuals from their designs. [...] Rayon is useful if you want a browser-based drafting tool focused on interiors, floor plans, and presentation-ready drawings. Rayon describes itself as professional-grade CAD software for interior architects and designers, with tools for floor plans, sections, elevations, millwork drawings, details, and other interior documents.

Rayon isn't primarily an AI-native floor plan generator. Use it when you want to draw, organize, style, and communicate interior layouts.

Rayon is a better fit when the floor plan is part of an interior design workflow: arranging rooms, documenting spaces, preparing drawings, and sharing a clear design direction. It's less useful if your main need is to generate a new custom home layout from room requirements, site constraints, or a blank canvas.
